title: Stability
description: A ball in a bowl comes back when pushed; a ball on a hill does not. Whether a fixed point is a bowl or a hill decides everything. Unlocks the Stability Margin.

puzzle.goal: Near a fixed point a disturbance x grows or shrinks as dx/dt = λx. Write the disturbance X after a time t, starting from x.
puzzle.name: Linear growth or decay
puzzle.ask: Find X for x = @{x}, λ = −0.5 and t = @{t} (a stable point: it dies away).
puzzle.method: The solution of dx/dt = λx is an exponential: for λ < 0 it shrinks (stable), for λ > 0 it grows (unstable).
